verdict.rationale: Lindy's security documentation states that customer data is never used to train models, so users get the outcome by default without needing an opt-out. The evidence is a single policy sentence on the security page with no supporting detail. Missing for 10: detail on whether third-party model providers (Lindy offers 'most major models') are contractually barred from training on user data, any documented DPA or contractual terms backing the no-training commitment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, never sold, and never used to train models.
